title: 不正IDは全体400、欠落でもtotalCount2、重複は保持
claim: sm9+sm0とsm9+形式不正は400 INVALID_PARAMETER。sm9+sm1は200/totalCount2だがitems1、sm1欠落。sm9重複指定は2件返却・異なるID1。返却件数やtotalCountだけで完了判定できない。
authentication: No Cookie/Authorization/key; browser CORS and logged-in membership untested.
unconfirmed: sm1 omission does not establish deletion/private status or its reason.
sm0 rejection cannot establish handling of every nonexistent ID.
totalCount is not generally defined by this sample; it does not equal returned item count in one observed response.
No rate limit, generic error recovery or browser runtime test.
